description: ERCOT grid: generation by fuel (daily MWh and share, or hourly MW), hourly system load with forecasts, or EIA daily ERCOT demand and generation. Free (no key or free key): the most recent 30 days of each series; a Pro key unlocks full history. Values are exact as published with unit, date and original source URL; incomplete days are flagged, never filled. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

fuel.description: Optional fuel filter for fuel_mix, e.g. Solar,Wind,Natural Gas

granularity.description: fuel_mix: day (default) or hour; load: hour; eia: day

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ending at the series' latest date. Older dates need a Pro key.

name: market_grid
